name: ns-bwa-advisory-lift-duration
description: At the moment a boil water advisory is issued for a public registered or municipal drinking water supply in Nova Scotia - known then: site name, county, facility type, reason for the report, calendar season, and the prior advisory history of the same site/county computed only from earlier advisories - will the advisory be lifted within 30 days?
split: temporal on advisory issue year: train 2008-2017, eval 2018-2020, holdout 2021-2024
split_description: temporal on advisory issue year: train 2008-2017, eval 2018-2020, holdout 2021-2024; population is advisories with a parseable issue date inside a window, issue date on or before the register vintage minus 30 days, and an observed non-negative duration at the pinned vintage; blank removal (still in effect) and negative-duration rows are excluded and counted per window
